title: Term 1 and 2 Examination
instructions: This paper covers the work of Terms 1 and 2.
This question paper consists of 4 questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Read each question carefully before you answer it.
Show your working, and round your answers as each question asks.

questions.prompt: Electricity rose from R1,80 to R2,07 per kWh. Calculate the percentage increase.
Unemployment rose from 32,1% to 33,9%. By how many percentage points did it rise?
Increasing a price by 20% and then decreasing it by 20% gives the original price.
A truck travels 360 km in 4 h 30 min. Calculate its average speed.
A car used 42 ℓ of petrol for a 560 km trip. Calculate its fuel consumption in ℓ/100 km, and the cost of the trip at R23,10/ℓ.
Estimate 498 × R21,95 without a calculator. Show how you estimated.

sections.title: QUESTION 2: Finance: Interest, Banking and Loans

questions.prompt: For the same rate and time, compound interest earns more than simple interest.
Which account usually earns the highest interest rate?
A TV costs R7 500 cash. On HP: R750 deposit plus 18 payments of R480. How much more than the cash price is paid on HP?
A pay-as-you-use account charges R4,50 per transaction plus R45 a month. A bundle account costs R99 per month. Which is cheaper for a customer who makes 15 transactions a month?
questions.memo:
✓ PAYU: R45 + 15 × R4,50 = R112,50 (1)
✓ Bundle: R99 (1)
✓ The bundle is cheaper (1)

questions.prompt: A loan is repaid with 36 monthly instalments of R1 250. What is the total amount repaid?
A person borrows R20 000 and repays R26 400 in total. How much interest was paid, and what percentage of the loan is this?
